milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the green wall banner (placed at spawn-relative [7, 2, 3] on the north exterior face of the stone brick structure at eye level) and face toward it, modeling 'the player can see the banner'. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable range across the open terrain, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the banner rather than facing away. This is preferred over position_inside_box because the task requires observation, not just proximity.

scene_description: An open grassy area with two structures: a stone brick building (5x5x4) to the east with a green wall banner on its north exterior face at eye level (y+2), and a smaller oak plank structure to the southwest as a distractor. task_text: Find the green wall banner. Explore the stone brick building and locate the green banner mounted on one of its exterior walls.

The torch at ~5 ~1 ~5 helps mark the west-side entrance. The oak plank structure at ~-5 to ~-3, ~1-3, ~-5 to ~-3 serves as a distractor. The /fill air command clears all trees in a 20x6x20 area above ground for clear visibility. The banner faces north, meaning its texture is visible when looking south from the north side of the building.
